scripts.audit:deps: npm audit --audit-level=high && osv-scanner scan source --lockfile package-lock.json
scripts.sast: semgrep scan --error --metrics off --config p/javascript --config p/typescript --config p/react --config p/nodejs
scripts.deploy: npm run release:guard && npm run check:live-schema && npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@15 deploy --only hosting --project vega-life-os --non-interactive
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@15 hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d --project vega-life-os --non-interactive
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run deadcode && npm run check:lockfile && npm run check:suppressions && npm run test && npm run dupes && npm run scan:secrets && npm run audit:deps && npm run e2e
